تقارصت (form VI)
# تَقَارَصْتُ (taqāraṣtu) /ta.qaː.rasˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
# تَقَارَصْتَ (taqāraṣta) /ta.qaː.rasˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
# تَقَارَصْتِ (taqāraṣti) /ta.qaː.rasˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
# تَقَارَصَتْ (taqāraṣat) /ta.qaː.ra.sˤat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
